facts.claim: The building of the premises at Mercara cost Rs. 32,548, with Coorgs contributing Rs. 9,720 and Europeans contributing Rs. 470.
facts.quote: they appear to have cost, independently of the Girls' Boarding House, built as before stated at private expense, Rs. 32,548, towards which the Coorgs subscribed Rs. 9,720 and Europeans in Coorg Es. 470.

facts.claim: The sale of the old school house yielded Bs. 6,500, with the remainder paid by the Government.
facts.quote: The sale of the old school house produced Bs. 6,500 and the rest was paid by Government.

facts.claim: The Coorgs and other inhabitants agreed not to send their children to be educated at a distance from home.
facts.quote: the Coorgs and other inhabitants with common consent excused themselves from parting with their children to be educated at a distance from home.
